name: visualrami
description: Online Rummy (Rami 51) with built-in video and voice chat between players

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w client & wait
